title: 20+ XSS Vulnerabilities Using a Simple Technique

title: Broken Social Login – Authentication Bypass Leading to Account Takeover
summary: The POST /api/v1/oauth/sociallogin endpoint authenticates users based entirely on client-supplied JSON and does not validate the identity token's signature, issuer, audience, or the binding between the supplied emailid / socialUId and a real Google/Firebase identity.
